title: TABS Survey Structure Summary - V2 (from Qualtrics QSF Export, March 2026)
revisionNotes: V2 removed Q9 (barrier category ranking) and Q10 (specific barrier ranking) based on pilot data analysis.
Q1b (Decision Authority) added to demographics; Top 3 barrier selection replaces forced rankings.
Attention checks redesigned as instructed-response items (IRIs); maturity AC added (3 total ACs).
QID236 (CAPTCHA) provides bot detection but is not a substantive survey item.
6 questions from V1 (QID215, QID227, QID229, QID230, QID234, QID235) were permanently deleted from the QSF during V2 revision.

revisionNotes.note: Added Rogers (2003) citation for Q1b (A1b / Demo_DecisionAuth). Updated items_with_citations count.

Replaced all citations with validated source from rebuild pipeline. 44 rows updated with specific dual citations, proper DOIs, and Zotero cross-references. Fixed missing Minor Barrier scale point in B14 / Barrier_PrivacyRisk, the privacy item. Added Zotero Key(s) and Zotero Status columns to complex view (mappedFields 13 to 15).
